recommended_approach: Use Mantaflow’s Python API surface via a gas fluid domain and a flow/emitter object: configure the simulation through `bpy.types.FluidDomainSettings` (domain-level controls, including noise animation/strength) and `bpy.types.FluidFlowSettings` (flow-level controls, including a noise texture hookup). For a slow, detailed candle-flame style motion, leverage the domain noise controls (`noise_strength`, `noise_time_anim`) and, where applicable, a flow noise texture (`noise_texture`) to drive subtle, time-varying detail.

bpy.types.FluidDomainSettings.noise_strength: (Fluid domain noise control; see API index entry for `noise_strength` on FluidDomainSettings)
bpy.types.FluidDomainSettings.noise_time_anim: (Fluid domain noise time animation; see API index entry for `noise_time_anim` on FluidDomainSettings)
bpy.types.FluidDomainSettings.flip_ratio: (Domain solver-related ratio; see API index entry for `flip_ratio` on FluidDomainSettings)

bpy.types.FluidFlowSettings.noise_texture: (Flow-level noise texture slot; see API index entry for `noise_texture` on FluidFlowSettings)
